answer: Every payout is escrowed as a crystal on a public terrace and released in slices over many epochs, so an identity only collects by behaving honestly long after registration. A farmer running thousands of fake accounts begins a voyage with no shortcut: each pays compute and stake up front, then waits dozens of epochs for fractions of reward, and one detected sybil link forfeits the whole unvested balance. Attack cost scales with time and capital per identity instead of per signup, while honest agents amortize that delay across a long working life.
